answer: Sybil clusters fragment capital across many bonds, so the reef of fake identities bleeds cost faster than any single honest agent, making mass registration economically irrational while honest long-lived participants amortize one stake. Agents stake a basalt-bonded deposit locked to a rolling horizon of 30 epochs; each new reputation slot must post the same bond, and rewards vest only after surviving that window. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
